text_block_list.text:
I spotted Daiwa Scarlet and Air Groove 
talking about something on the track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Air Groove-senpai! How was 
my run?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...At first glance, it's a well-balanced 
run. On the other hand, it leaves the 
impression of lacking a distinct 
'strength.'"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Strengths," is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps I should call it "being 
yourself." Your true "strength" should lie 
somewhere else entirely.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me! What are my strengths, 
seen from your perspective, Senpai?!
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear Air Groove's opinion too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—No, wait! Trainer, geez, don't scare me 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Impolite, coming in without a 
greeting— but I shall overlook it in light 
of your passion for the Umamusume in your 
charge.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, by passion, do you mean—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...For example, when running with Vodka, 
her true colors should have shone through.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The sheer hunger to push ahead of the 
opponent by even a single step. The 
unyielding strength to never lose in a 
head-to-head clash.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That's as much as I can tell you. What 
you do after hearing it is up to you."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Make the most of it. For her sake.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's discuss our training going 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes♪ Let's get started right away, 
Trainer... san!
choice_data_list:
You're being pretty obedient today, that 
makes things quick.

You're being so cooperative today, that 
makes things easy, doesn't it?
For now, let's run on dirt!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wha—what's with that loaded phrasing?! It 
sounds like you're saying I'm never 
reasonable!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Wait, that's wrong!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Senpai... um, this is, well—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Keep at it, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Grrrgh! Hey! You threw off my rhythm, you 
know!
choice_data_list: Why not just do things like we always do?

Doing things the usual way is totally 
fine, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's NOT okay! Geez— you'd better take 
responsibility for this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and design a training regimen 
that incorporates your senpai's advice!

She still seemed to be in a bad mood after 
that, but she took her training very 
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! That's way too out of 
nowhere! We literally just said we were 
going to talk it over!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you pull this kind of stuff way 
too often! Just suddenly shouting, 'Let's 
do this!' and all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even today, while I was talking with my 
senior, suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Senpai... um, this is, well—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Keep at it, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Aah, geez! It's because you went and made 
them mad~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, and right in front of my senpai, 
too...
choice_data_list:
The usual really is the most comforting, 
huh.

The usual really is the most comforting, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.text:

bit, have you!? Good grief, this is why 
you always...
